title: Human Resource Management
award: Certificate of Achievement requiring 16S/24Q to fewer than 30S/45Q units

program.section_heading: Human Resource Management Certificate of Achievement
outcomes: At the conclusion of this program, the student should be able to analyze and interpret the legal and ethical frameworks governing Human Resource Management.

At the conclusion of this program, the student should be able to demonstrate proficiency in utilizing technology to optimize human resource functions, including recruitment, onboarding, employee relations, performance management, and organizational communication, by applying relevant human resource techniques and best practices.

At the conclusion of this program, the student should be able to explain how Federal, State, and local laws affect public and private employers, and apply this knowledge to ensure organizational compliance and promote equitable treatment in the workplace.

At the conclusion of this program, the student should be able toevaluate labor relations and collective bargaining agreements in both public and private sectors and analyze their impact and implications.
